result.instructions: Tools for Gingr, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gingr data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run gingr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gingr_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gingr_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. gingr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gingr_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (facilities) of this Gingr app, as id (value) + name (label). Good first call: most other tools take a location_id. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_locations.

tools.name: gingr_list_reservation_types
tools.title: List reservation types
tools.description: List the reservation types (services such as boarding, daycare, grooming, training) with their ids. Use the ids to filter reservations or to read a type's add-on services. Gingr: GET /api/v1/reservation_types.

tools.name: gingr_list_services_by_type
tools.title: List add-on services of a reservation type
tools.description: List the additional services (add-ons) allowed for a reservation type, e.g. baths or nail trims on a boarding stay. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_services_by_type.

annotations.title: List add-on services of a reservation type

tools.name: gingr_list_reference
tools.title: List reference data
tools.description: List one kind of reference data of this Gingr app: species, breeds, temperaments, vets (veterinarians with details), retail_items (retail items for sale) or immunization_types (of one species; needs species_id). Paged. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_species | get_breeds | get_temperaments | get_vets | get_all_retail_items | get_immunization_types.

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: gingr_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations in a date range
tools.description: List all reservations (boarding, daycare, grooming, training…) between two dates, at most 30 days apart (Gingr's limit). Paged: total, next_offset, items. Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations (checked_in=false).

end_date.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 30 days after start_date.

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

annotations.title: List reservations in a date range

tools.name: gingr_list_checked_in
tools.title: List pets checked in now
tools.description: List the reservations that are checked in right now (the pets currently on site). Paged. Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations (checked_in=true).

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: gingr_get_daily_summary
tools.title: Get the day's check-in / check-out summary
tools.description: Get the summary of reservations for one date: number of check-ins, check-outs and overnights (the widget at the top of the Gingr dashboard). Gingr: GET /api/v1/reservation_widget_data.

annotations.title: Get the day's check-in / check-out summary

tools.name: gingr_get_whiteboard
tools.title: Get today's arrivals and departures (whiteboard)
tools.description: Get the pets checking in and checking out today at a location, by reservation type, with owner/pet names, times, run and status (Gingr's Digital Whiteboard). Gingr: GET /api/v1/back_of_house.

type_ids.description: Reservation type ids to include (from gingr_list_reservation_types).

full_day.description: true (default) = every reservation checking in/out today; false = use mins_future.

mins_future.description: With full_day=false: only the next/last this many minutes.

tools.name: gingr_list_owner_reservations
tools.title: List an owner's reservations
tools.description: List the reservations of one owner (customer), optionally only pending requests, current, future, past or wait-listed ones, by dates, types or pets. Only the location the API user is logged into is included (Gingr). Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations_by_owner.

to_date.description: Only reservations up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

reservation_type_ids.description: Only these reservation type ids (from gingr_list_reservation_types).

limit.description: Return at most this many reservations (1-200, default 50).

tools.name: gingr_list_animal_reservations
tools.title: List a pet's reservations
tools.description: List the reservations of one animal (pet), optionally only pending requests, current, future, past or wait-listed ones, by dates or types. Only the location the API user is logged into is included (Gingr). Gingr: POST /api/v1/reservations_by_animal.

to_date.description: Only reservations up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

reservation_type_ids.description: Only these reservation type ids (from gingr_list_reservation_types).

limit.description: Return at most this many reservations (1-200, default 50).

tools.name: gingr_list_cancelled_reservations
tools.title: List recently cancelled reservations
tools.description: List the reservations that were cancelled between two dates (at most 31 days apart). Paged. Gingr: POST /api/v1/recently_cancelled_reservations.

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: gingr_get_reservation_estimate
tools.title: Get a reservation's cost estimate
tools.description: Get the estimated cost of an existing (future) reservation. Gingr: GET /api/v1/existing_reservation_estimate.

tools.name: gingr_list_owners
tools.title: List owners (customers)
tools.description: List owners (pet parents / customers) with contact details, balance and reservation counts, optionally filtered by exact first/last name, email, cell phone, ZIP or home location. Paged. Gingr: GET /api/v1/owners (filters as params[<field>]). Passwords and payment-card references are removed.

cell_phone.description: Exact cell phone as stored in Gingr, e.g. (555) 555-5555.

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: gingr_get_owner
tools.title: Get an owner
tools.description: Get one owner (customer) record by exactly one of: owner id, one of their pets' id, one of their reservations' id, cell phone or email. Gingr: GET /api/v1/owner. Passwords and payment-card references are removed.

animal_id.description: Find the owner of this animal (pet).

reservation_id.description: Find the owner of this reservation.

tools.name: gingr_list_new_modified_owners
tools.title: List new or changed owners
tools.description: List the owners (customers) created or modified between two dates (at most 366 days apart). Paged. Gingr: POST /api/v1/new_modified_owners.

location_id.description: Only owners whose home location is this location id.

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: gingr_list_animals
tools.title: List animals (pets)
tools.description: List animals (pets) with species, breed, birthday, weight, owner and notes, optionally filtered by owner, exact name, species or breed. Paged. Gingr: GET /api/v1/animals (filters as params[<field>]).

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: gingr_get_animal_immunizations
tools.title: Get a pet's immunization records
tools.description: Get the immunization (vaccination) records of one animal, with expiration dates. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_animal_immunizations.

tools.name: gingr_get_animal_feeding
tools.title: Get a pet's feeding instructions
tools.description: Get the feeding information of one animal (food, amounts, schedule). Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_feeding_info.

tools.name: gingr_get_animal_medications
tools.title: Get a pet's medications
tools.description: Get the medication information of one animal (medications, doses, schedule). Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_medication_info.

tools.name: gingr_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices or estimates
tools.description: List invoices (complete=true) or estimates (complete=false, Gingr's default) created on or after 2019-08-01, optionally closed only and by date range. Paged by Gingr: per_page + start (the 1-based number of the first result; the next page starts at start + per_page). Gingr: GET /api/v1/list_invoices.

start.description: 1-based number of the first result (default 1; page 2 of 25 = 26).

tools.name: gingr_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a POS transaction
tools.description: Get one point-of-sale transaction with its items and payment details (card numbers, processor references and auth codes are removed). Gingr: POST /api/v1/transaction.

tools.name: gingr_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions (packages)
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions (membership packages), optionally of one owner, location or package, by billing day, including cancelled ones if asked. Paged by Gingr (limit + offset). Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_subscriptions.

bill_day_of_month.description: Only subscriptions renewing on this day of the month.

offset.description: Skip this many records (paging; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: gingr_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription (membership package) by id. Gingr: GET /api/v1/get_subscription.

tools.name: gingr_get_timeclock_report
tools.title: Get the staff timeclock report
tools.description: Get staff timeclock records (clock-ins/outs, hours) at a location between two dates (at most 31 days apart). Gingr: GET /api/v1/timeclock_report.

include_clocked_in.description: true = include staff still clocked in.

tools.name: gingr_list_report_card_files
tools.title: List recent report card files
tools.description: List recently uploaded report card files (photos and videos shared with pet parents), newest first. Gingr: GET /api/v1/report_card_files.

limit.description: Return at most this many files (1-200, default 50).
